================
File: script.js
================
const letters = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".split("");
let upcomingQuestions = [...letters];
let wrongCount = 0;
let totalTime = 0;
let consecutiveTimeouts = 0;
let currentLetter = "";
let timer;
let questionStartTime;
let isRoundActive = false;

const startBtn = document.getElementById("start-btn");
const optionsDiv = document.getElementById("options");
const progressFill = document.getElementById("progress-fill");
const wrongCountSpan = document.getElementById("wrong-count");
const correctAnswerDiv = document.getElementById("correct-answer");
const gameOverDiv = document.getElementById("game-over");
const playAgainBtn = document.getElementById("play-again");

// Audio setup
const sounds = {
  whichLetterSays: new Audio("whichLetterSays.mp3"),
  wrong: new Audio("buzzer.mp3"),
  says: new Audio("says.mp3"),
  letterNames: {},
  letterSounds: {},
};
letters.forEach((letter) => {
  sounds.letterNames[letter] = new Audio(`${letter}-name.mp3`);
  sounds.letterSounds[letter] = new Audio(`${letter}-sound.mp3`);
});

function shuffle(array) {
  for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
  }
  return array;
}

function playSequentialAudio(audioArray, callback) {
  let i = 0;
  function playNext() {
    if (i < audioArray.length) {
      const audio = audioArray[i];
      audio.currentTime = 0;
      audio.play().catch((err) => {
        console.error("Audio playback failed:", err);
        audio.onended = null;
        i++;
        playNext();
      });
      audio.onended = () => {
        audio.onended = null;
        i++;
        playNext();
      };
    } else if (callback) {
      console.log("Audio sequence complete, running callback");
      callback();
    }
  }
  playNext();
}

function formatTime(seconds) {
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const remainingSeconds = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
  return minutes > 0
    ? `${minutes} minute${
        minutes !== 1 ? "s" : ""
      } and ${remainingSeconds} second${remainingSeconds !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`
    : `${remainingSeconds} second${remainingSeconds !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`;
}

function showGameOver() {
  document.getElementById(
    "wrong-count-display"
  ).textContent = `Wrong Answers: ${wrongCount}`;
  document.getElementById(
    "total-time-display"
  ).textContent = `Total Response Time: ${formatTime(totalTime)}`;
  gameOverDiv.style.display = "block";
  isRoundActive = false;
}

function stopAllSounds() {
  sounds.whichLetterSays.pause();
  sounds.wrong.pause();
  sounds.says.pause();
  for (let letter in sounds.letterNames) {
    sounds.letterNames[letter].pause();
    sounds.letterNames[letter].currentTime = 0;
  }
  for (let letter in sounds.letterSounds) {
    sounds.letterSounds[letter].pause();
    sounds.letterSounds[letter].currentTime = 0;
  }
}

function startRound() {
  if (isRoundActive) return;
  isRoundActive = true;
  clearTimeout(timer);
  progressFill.style.width = "100%";
  progressFill.style.transition = "none";
  if (upcomingQuestions.length === 0) {
    showGameOver();
    return;
  }
  currentLetter = upcomingQuestions.shift();
  playSequentialAudio(
    [sounds.whichLetterSays, sounds.letterSounds[currentLetter]],
    () => {
      questionStartTime = Date.now();
      let options = [currentLetter];
      while (options.length < 4) {
        const randomLetter =
          letters[Math.floor(Math.random() * letters.length)];
        if (!options.includes(randomLetter)) options.push(randomLetter);
      }
      shuffle(options);
      optionsDiv.innerHTML = `
          <div class="row g-3">
              <div class="col-2"></div>
              <div class="col-3 option" onclick="checkAnswer('${
                options[0]
              }')">${options[0].toUpperCase()}</div>
              <div class="col-2"></div>
              <div class="col-3 option" onclick="checkAnswer('${
                options[1]
              }')">${options[1].toUpperCase()}</div>
              <div class="col-2"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="row g-3">
              <div class="col-2"></div>
              <div class="col-3 option" onclick="checkAnswer('${
                options[2]
              }')">${options[2].toUpperCase()}</div>
              <div class="col-2"></div>
              <div class="col-3 option" onclick="checkAnswer('${
                options[3]
              }')">${options[3].toUpperCase()}</div>
              <div class="col-2"></div>
          </div>
      `;
      progressFill.style.transition = "width 4s linear";
      progressFill.style.width = "0%";
      timer = setTimeout(() => handleWrongAnswer(true), 4000);
    }
  );
}

function checkAnswer(selected) {
  if (!isRoundActive) return;
  clearTimeout(timer);
  const timeTaken = Math.min((Date.now() - questionStartTime) / 1000, 4);
  totalTime += timeTaken;
  progressFill.style.transition = "none"; // Stop animation
  optionsDiv.innerHTML = "";
  correctAnswerDiv.textContent = currentLetter.toUpperCase();
  correctAnswerDiv.style.display = "block";
  correctAnswerDiv.classList.add("flash");
  if (selected === currentLetter) {
    consecutiveTimeouts = 0;
    sounds.letterNames[selected].play();
    setTimeout(() => {
      correctAnswerDiv.style.display = "none";
      correctAnswerDiv.classList.remove("flash");
      isRoundActive = false; // Reset here after correct answer
      startRound();
    }, 1000);
  } else {
    handleWrongAnswer(false); // Keep isRoundActive true until handled
  }
}

function handleWrongAnswer(isTimeout = false) {
  if (!isRoundActive) return;
  if (isTimeout) {
    consecutiveTimeouts++;
    if (consecutiveTimeouts >= 3) {
      showGameOver();
      return;
    }
  }
  const timeTaken = isTimeout
    ? 4
    : Math.min((Date.now() - questionStartTime) / 1000, 4);
  totalTime += timeTaken;
  if (!isTimeout) wrongCount++;
  wrongCountSpan.textContent = wrongCount;
  progressFill.style.transition = "none"; // Stop animation
  optionsDiv.innerHTML = "";
  correctAnswerDiv.textContent = currentLetter.toUpperCase();
  correctAnswerDiv.style.display = "block";
  correctAnswerDiv.classList.add("flash");
  playSequentialAudio(
    [
      sounds.wrong,
      sounds.letterNames[currentLetter],
      sounds.says,
      sounds.letterSounds[currentLetter],
    ],
    () => {
      console.log("Wrong answer feedback complete, proceeding");
      correctAnswerDiv.style.display = "none";
      correctAnswerDiv.classList.remove("flash");
      if (upcomingQuestions.length > 0) {
        upcomingQuestions.splice(1, 0, currentLetter);
      } else {
        upcomingQuestions.push(currentLetter);
      }
      isRoundActive = false; // Reset here after wrong answer
      startRound();
    }
  );
}

startBtn.onclick = () => {
  startBtn.style.display = "none";
  shuffle(upcomingQuestions);
  startRound();
};

playAgainBtn.onclick = () => {
  gameOverDiv.style.display = "none";
  upcomingQuestions = [...letters];
  wrongCount = 0;
  totalTime = 0;
  consecutiveTimeouts = 0;
  wrongCountSpan.textContent = wrongCount;
  startBtn.style.display = "block";
  stopAllSounds();
  shuffle(upcomingQuestions);
};

// Service Worker Registration
if ("serviceWorker" in navigator) {
  window.addEventListener("load", () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker
      .register("/service-worker.js")
      .then((reg) => console.log("Service Worker registered:", reg))
      .catch((err) => console.log("Service Worker registration failed:", err));
  });
}

// PWA Install Prompt
let deferredPrompt;
window.addEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  deferredPrompt = e;
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (
      deferredPrompt &&
      confirm("Install Phonics Speed Challenge for offline play?")
    ) {
      deferredPrompt.prompt();
      deferredPrompt.userChoice.then((choiceResult) => {
        if (choiceResult.outcome === "accepted") {
          console.log("User installed the PWA");
        }
        deferredPrompt = null;
      });
    }
  }, 3000);
});

File: service-worker.js

const CACHE_NAME = "phonics-quiz-v1";
const FILES_TO_CACHE = [
  "/index.html",
  "/manifest.json",
  "/whichLetterSays.mp3",
  "/bell.mp3",
  "/buzzer.mp3",
  "/says.mp3",
  "/victory1.mp3",
  "/victory2.mp3",
  "/a-name.mp3",
  "/b-name.mp3",
  "/c-name.mp3",
  "/d-name.mp3",
  "/e-name.mp3",
  "/f-name.mp3",
  "/g-name.mp3",
  "/h-name.mp3",
  "/i-name.mp3",
  "/j-name.mp3",
  "/k-name.mp3",
  "/l-name.mp3",
  "/m-name.mp3",
  "/n-name.mp3",
  "/o-name.mp3",
  "/p-name.mp3",
  "/q-name.mp3",
  "/r-name.mp3",
  "/s-name.mp3",
  "/t-name.mp3",
  "/u-name.mp3",
  "/v-name.mp3",
  "/w-name.mp3",
  "/x-name.mp3",
  "/y-name.mp3",
  "/z-name.mp3",
  "/a-sound.mp3",
  "/b-sound.mp3",
  "/c-sound.mp3",
  "/d-sound.mp3",
  "/e-sound.mp3",
  "/f-sound.mp3",
  "/g-sound.mp3",
  "/h-sound.mp3",
  "/i-sound.mp3",
  "/j-sound.mp3",
  "/k-sound.mp3",
  "/l-sound.mp3",
  "/m-sound.mp3",
  "/n-sound.mp3",
  "/o-sound.mp3",
  "/p-sound.mp3",
  "/q-sound.mp3",
  "/r-sound.mp3",
  "/s-sound.mp3",
  "/t-sound.mp3",
  "/u-sound.mp3",
  "/v-sound.mp3",
  "/w-sound.mp3",
  "/x-sound.mp3",
  "/y-sound.mp3",
  "/z-sound.mp3",
];

self.addEventListener("install", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => {
      console.log("Caching files");
      return cache.addAll(FILES_TO_CACHE);
    })
  );
});

self.addEventListener("fetch", (event) => {
  event.respondWith(
    caches.match(event.request).then((response) => {
      return response || fetch(event.request);
    })
  );
});

self.addEventListener("activate", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((cacheNames) => {
      return Promise.all(
        cacheNames.map((name) => {
          if (name !== CACHE_NAME) {
            return caches.delete(name);
          }
        })
      );
    })
  );
});
